jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager: new business
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Granular Energy

Mission & Vision

Granular is a fast-growing climate tech startup paving the way towards a carbon-free grid.

We provide a portfolio management platform and trading services to utilities, suppliers and energy traders. The platform helps solve the complex issue of hourly matching between clean energy generation and consumption, at scale. You can find out more about the 24/7 energy space in this article.

Initially founded in 2021, our team is now around 30 people. We have clients in the US, Europe and Asia, and our team is primarily located in western Europe.

This is your opportunity to work on a product that's creating a pathway to a fully clean energy grid. Your efforts will have a direct and sizeable contribution to the climate transition.

Remote-first

Granular Energy is a remote-first organisation. We are flexible on locations that are within a train ride from Paris. There will be regular team calls in the morning, and three all-hands gatherings each year (most recently Brussels, London and Amsterdam). Travel to industry events and customer meetings, primarily in the UK and Europe, will also be part of the role.

What's the mission of this role?

This role exists to identify and help to validate the next wave of products at Granular Energy, beyond our core enterprise platform.

Our core platform (EAC management and hourly matching) has reached strong product-market fit, with customers across Europe, the US and Asia. We now want a dedicated person who can run the full zero-to-one cycle on adjacent opportunities: a battery-options and virtual-toll marketplace, ETRM extensions for trading desks, ESNA-related extensions, and other adjacencies that the energy transition will surface.

You will have significant autonomy on what to pursue, and a direct line to the rest of the commercial, product and engineering teams for prototyping and when an opportunity is ready to scale.

Who we are looking for!

Core responsibilities

  • Support sales of our core platform

  • Identify and evaluate new commercial opportunities adjacent to the core platform

  • Run primary market research through expert and customer interviews

  • Be involved in developing prototypes using AI tooling

  • Run small-scale market tests and

  • Close first paying customers on test products (from existing or new logos)

  • Develop business cases for promising opportunities and present them to the executive team

  • Hand validated opportunities cleanly to the wider commercial and product teams for scaling

  • Work with our tech team to build minimum-viable prototypes using AI tooling and demo them with prospects

Essential experiences, competencies and knowledge

  • Significant experience in the power market (typically 5+ years), from one of: energy consulting, trading (utility, IPP or fund), or strategy / corporate development inside an energy company

  • Demonstrated track record of identifying and pursuing new commercial opportunities; entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in ambiguous early-stage work

  • Strong network in the UK and / or European power market across suppliers, traders, generators, optimisers and regulators

  • Strategic thinker who can move quickly from market signal to thesis to validated test

  • Hands-on technical capability; comfortable using modern AI tooling (Claude, Cursor, Replit and similar) to build prototypes and demos independently

  • Strong commercial instincts and willingness to do early sales independently

  • Stellar communication and organisational skills

Bonus points for

  • Experience in startup and / or remote environments

  • Direct experience in flexibility, battery, EAC or hourly matching markets

  • Product or product management background

  • Existing network at any of European Tier 1 utilities, IPPs, energy traders, corporate energy consumers

What's in it for you

  • Transparent salaries based on seniority and location (see "compensation" section)

  • Remote first: WFH, or your local co-working space

  • Three all-hands gatherings each year (typically in Europe): most recently Brussels, London and Amsterdam

  • Minimum 30 days holiday (plus public holidays)

  • Physical and mental health: gym subsidies and access to therapy via Spill

  • Equity: earn equity in a fast-growing company (BSPCE/EMI)

  • Make your mark on an early-stage climate product in a high-impact space

DEI Statement

Granular Energy is dedicated to fostering diversity and nurturing talent. If you don't possess all the skills listed above but believe you have the qualities we're seeking, we encourage you to reach out. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building an inclusive team.

We look for candidates who have a high level of demonstrated comfort with cultural competency. People of colour, people with disabilities, veterans, women, lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender people are encouraged to apply. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, colour, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, sex, marital or parental status, disability, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Our recruitment process

  • Initial 30-minute screening call with our recruiter

  • A first 60-minute interview with peers from the commercial team

  • Take-home assignment (1-3 hours): a market-exploration brief for a new opportunity for Granular

  • Final interview(s) with various members of the executive team

jobs.title: Customer Delivery Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Granular Energy

Granular is a fast-growing climate tech startup developing a platform to help the electricity system transition towards 24/7 clean energy. You can find out more about the 24/7 energy space in this article.

Our SaaS platform provides portfolio management solutions to electricity companies and suppliers, to help them solve the issue of hourly matching between green generation and consumption, at scale.

We are active across Europe and the US and have partnered with Europe’s leading power exchange and grid operators, among others. Following a recent oversubscribed funding round, we are extremely well funded with a long runway.

We are dedicated to fostering diversity and nurturing talent. If you don't possess all the skills listed below but believe you have the qualities we're seeking, we encourage you to reach out. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building an inclusive team.

What’s the mission of this role?

This role is a hands-on manager to oversee our Technical Solutions/Customer Delivery team (from a team of 5 and budget already allocated for new hires), at the crossroads between Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams, and in direct interaction with our clients.

At Granular Energy, we build and deliver a first-of-a-kind green portfolio management platform, to energy suppliers and retailers. Once signed, the implementation of a project will be facilitated by a mix of “Customer Success” and “Technical Solutions” teams. Their role is to ensure a smooth delivery of our software to (often large) enterprise clients, from onboarding, integration design, to recurrent client operations. Occasionally, they will also help in pre-sales activities, advising prospects and clients, or relaying the product in client demos.

We’re looking for an experienced individual that will be able to i) manage the team ii) implement changes (structure, processes) to operationalise our Implementation and Delivery processes and iii) is hands on / can manage some of the accounts (in particular, the complex ones).

The role is strategically important to our activity, and interacts with all parts of our business including our commercial, product and technical activities. It is a great opportunity to make an impact and drive change in the energy industry, but also to learn from different departments at Granular and unlock growth opportunities in several of them!

Note: In other companies, the team members could be called a Client Solutions Manager, Technical Account Manager, Delivery or Implementation Lead Manager. Our team members are business experts, able to understand complex environments, and design elegant solutions.

Who we are looking for!

Responsibilities of this role

  • Implement operational and cultural changes, bringing project discipline and rationalisation of delivered use cases

  • Implement and improve processes, especially around streamlining customer integration

  • Oversee the whole client delivery activity and provide synthetic reporting on the health of ongoing projects to other key managers in the company. Know when to escalate and when to get your hands dirty to unblock a situation

  • Manage the team: supervise work, dispatch work and accounts, organise team planning and team rituals, performance management

  • Manage some implementation projects for few accounts on their own, with support from the existing team, to support delivery and familiarise themselves with the work

    • analyse systems (ETRMs, billing systems / ERPs, CRM) and dissect data representations in our clients’ environments, with a high level of detail and rigour, to inform integration strategies

    • design robust data/integration pipelines with our SaaS portfolio management software that often require thinking outside the box

    • when necessary, take part in the implementation of those integrations (scripting). Important note though: this is not an engineer role

  • Relentlessly seek for fixes and improvements to the way our projects are delivered, and engage our customers in resolution/improvement plans until delivered.

  • Identifying new opportunities to solve pain points for our customers, either through upselling other parts of our platform, or through projects to develop new platform capabilities for our customers (working closely with our commercial and product teams)

  • Contributing to product and other cross-functional projects when required

Essential experiences, competencies & knowledge

  • STEM education

  • Experience of SaaS implementation or any role that involves practical experience in figuring out complex business processes from data and analysis such as business analyst, consultants or auditors, ideally in the energy, commodity trading, banking industry or at SaaS vendors.

  • Experience managing a team: performance assessment, assigning workload, etc.

  • Excellent (remote) communication skills, and the ability to interact with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders

  • Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving skills, with acute attention to detail

  • Knowledge of a scripting language (preferably Python) / ability to drive LLMs in a controlled way to automate some workflows

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment, working under tight deadlines, while keeping a high level of quality in your work

  • Advanced proficiency with Excel and other office tools such as Powerpoint

  • Fluent in English

Bonus points for

  • Experience in startup and/or remote environments is a strong plus

  • Knowledge of typical systems used in the energy industry (energy retail CRM, ETRM and other front-to-back solutions, accounting software) and typical functions and processes in a utility business (front-office teams and process, middle-office/risk, back-office)

What’s in it for you!

  • Remote first: WFH or your local co-working space

  • Three all-hands gatherings each year: most recently in Rotterdam, Brussels, Paris

  • 30 days holiday (plus public holidays)

  • Physical & mental health: we offer gym subsidies and access to therapy via Spill

  • Equity: share options in a fast-growing company (BSPCE/EMI)

  • Make your mark on an early-stage climate product in a high-impact space

DEI Statement

Granular Energy is dedicated to fostering diversity and nurturing talent. If you don't possess all the skills listed above but believe you have the qualities we're seeking, we encourage you to reach out. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building an inclusive team.

We look for candidates who have a high level of demonstrated comfort with cultural competency. People of colour, people with disabilities, veterans, women, lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender people are encouraged to apply. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, colour, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, sex, marital or parental status, disability, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Location/remote-first

Granular Energy is a remote-first organisation and this role is 100% remote. We hire employees that live in mainland Western & Central-West Europe (e.g. France, Germany, Austria, northern Italy, the Netherlands, Belgium, northern Spain, or mainland UK) so they can get to Paris, Brussels, Amsterdam, or London by train within a reasonable time frame 3 times per year (either night train or half-day ride).

A bit more about our product

Our product currently consists of a portfolio management solution for energy suppliers, retailers, utilities, traders. It helps our clients model their portfolio of supply and demand in a comprehensive way, and manage and optimise the flow and attribution of carbon-free energy within this portfolio. It supports the launch and service of new-generation, more transparent green offers, while helping portfolio managers streamline their operations and risk management. We would welcome your thoughts and questions on this value proposition, in our first screening interview.

Our recruitment process

  • 20-minute screening call by [name] from the People team

  • Initial interview with Technical Solutions team members

  • Live case study + technical interview with Technical Solutions team - 90 mins

  • Final 30 to 60 minute with C-level
